findings.description: PlatoMark icon color in FitCard header deviates from spec. Spec section 2 item 5 explicitly states: 'Header: 15px PlatoMark (in `colors.gray[700]`)' — a single fixed value with no dark-mode variant. Implementation passes `color={theme.dark ? theme.color.gray[400] : theme.color.gray[700]}`, adding a dark-mode branch not present in the spec. Per CLAUDE.md known failure pattern 12 (spec-implementation mismatch is never MED): 'If the spec says X and the implementation does Y, that is HIGH or BLOCKER — even if Y is functionally equivalent.' The spec says `colors.gray[700]`; the implementation does a dark-mode ternary. The user decides whether the deviation is acceptable.
